title: User Control Panel (UCP) Registration
description:
Welcome to **{BOT_NAME}**!
Before joining the server, all players must register a UCP account. This links your Discord profile to your in-game identity and server stats.

fields.name: 📌 How to Register
fields.value:
1. Click the **Register UCP** button below.
2. Complete the required account credentials in the prompt.
3. Wait for database verification.
4. Your account will automatically link and assign player permissions.

fields.name: ⚠️ Rules & Guidelines
fields.value:
• One UCP account per person. Multi-accounting is strictly prohibited.
• Use a valid name format according to server roleplay guidelines.
• Never share your account credentials with anyone, including staff.
